title: 第11章 诺克萨斯断头台第12章 当前拯救进度 99％
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
;;
那柄战斧出现得毫无征兆。
前一秒，肖恩手中还空无一物，下一秒，空气仿佛被某种沉重的东西挤压得变形。
一把通体漆黑，造型狂野的双刃巨斧凭空落在他掌心。
斧柄长达一米五，粗糙的握感带着冰凉，斧面宽阔得像两扇门板，暗红色的血槽里似乎还残留着上古战场的硝烟。
黑色切割者。
三百斤的重量压在手上，换做昨天的肖恩，恐怕挥起来有些费劲。
但此刻，拥有【嫪毐之躯】的他只觉得这分量刚刚好，沉甸甸的坠手感反而让人心安。
体内那股躁动的热流找到了宣泄口，顺着手臂疯狂涌入斧柄。
“装神弄鬼。”
刀疤脸冷笑一声，手中的双手剑一挥，没打算讲什么骑士精神，“上，注意别把那女人弄伤了。”
马蹄声炸响。
三名黑甲骑士率先冲锋。
借着战马的冲势，三柄骑枪以此品字形扎向肖恩的胸口和腹部。
这种配合他们练过无数次，哪怕是四阶练气士，硬扛这一击也得被捅成筛子。
肖恩没躲。
他只是把巨斧拖在身后，身形微侧。
骑枪锋利的尖端甚至已经刺破了他衣领处的布料。
就是现在。
肖恩腰腹发力，脊椎大龙猛地一抖，那柄沉睡的凶兽苏醒了。

《蛮荒斧法》第一式——开山。
没有什么花哨的技巧，就是纯粹的力量与速度的结合。
巨斧在半空中划出一道黑色的满月，带着撕裂空气的尖啸，横扫而出。
当！
第一声脆响，是精钢打造的骑枪被拦腰砸断。
紧接着是第二声、第三声。
断裂的枪头飞向半空。
但黑色切割者的去势未减半分，那黑色的斧刃像是切豆腐一样，毫不讲理地撞上了第一匹战马的胸甲。
并没有预想中金属碰撞的火星四溅。
只有令人牙酸的嗤啦声。
那号称能抵御重弩射击的黑铁铠甲，在黑色切割者的被动效果削甲面前，脆弱得像一张薄纸。
斧刃切入血肉，连带着马背上的骑士一起，被这股蛮横至极的怪力直接掀飞。
连人带马，横飞出五六米远，砸在路边的土沟里。
剩下两名骑士哪怕训练有素，此刻也吓得魂飞魄散，拼命勒马想要转向。
可肖恩根本不给机会。

The battle ax appeared without warning.
One second, there was nothing in Sean's hand, and the next second, the air seemed to be squeezed and deformed by something heavy.
A dark, wild double-edged giant ax fell out of thin air into his palm.
The handle of the ax is one meter and a half long, and its rough grip is cold. The ax is as wide as two door panels, and the dark red blood groove seems to still contain smoke from the ancient battlefield.
Black Cutter.
With three hundred kilograms of weight on his hands, it would have been a bit difficult for Sean to swing it yesterday.
But at this moment, with [Lao Ai's body], he just felt that the weight was just right, and the heavy feeling of falling into his hand was reassuring.
The restless heat in his body found an outlet and flowed crazily down his arm into the ax handle.
"Pretend to be a ghost."
Scarface sneered and waved the two-handed sword in his hand. He didn't intend to talk about chivalry. "Come on, be careful not to hurt that woman."
The sound of horse hooves exploded.
Three black-armored knights took the lead in charging.
Taking advantage of the momentum of the war horse, three lances pierced Sean's chest and abdomen in a zigzag pattern.
They had practiced this kind of coordination countless times. Even a fourth-level Qi practitioner would be smashed into pieces even if he could withstand this attack.
Sean didn't hide.
He just dragged the giant ax behind him, leaning slightly.
The sharp tip of the lance even pierced the fabric of his collar.
That's it now.
Sean exerted force on his waist and abdomen, his spine shook violently, and the sleeping beast came to life.
The first form of "Wild Axe Technique" - Mountain Creation.
No fancy tricks, just pure power and speed.
The giant ax drew a black full moon in mid-air, and swept out with a scream that tore the air.
when!
The first crisp sound was the lance made of fine steel being smashed in half.
Then came the second and third sounds.
The broken gun head flew into the air.
But the black cutter's castration was not reduced by half. The black ax blade hit the first war horse's breastplate unreasonably like cutting tofu.
There were no sparks flying as expected from the metal collision.
There was only a heart-wrenching hissing sound.
The black iron armor, which was said to be able to withstand heavy crossbow fire, was as fragile as a thin piece of paper in front of the black cutter's passive effect.
The ax blade cut into flesh and blood, and the knight on horseback was directly thrown away by this extremely arrogant and strange force.
The man and the horse flew five to six meters away and crashed into a ditch on the roadside.
Even though the remaining two knights were well-trained, they were frightened out of their wits at this moment. They desperately reined in their horses and tried to turn.
But Sean didn't give him a chance.
